description: This file is a Java JUnit test class for the CustomAuditingHandler component in the Apache Fineract project. It tests the auditing functionality such as marking objects as created or modified and validates that date fields are correctly set according to the current system date/time.

classes.name: CustomAuditingHandlerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for CustomAuditingHandler, testing auditing annotations for creation and modification timestamps.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up tenant and business date context before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets thread-local context after each test.

methods.name: markCreated
methods.description: Tests that markCreated sets the createdDate field correctly.

methods.name: markModified
methods.description: Tests that markModified sets the lastModifiedDate field correctly.

methods.name: markModifiedOldDateTimeProvider
methods.description: Tests markModified using the older LocalDateTime provider.

methods.name: markCreatedOldDateTimeProvider
methods.description: Tests markCreated using the older LocalDateTime provider.
